capabilities: Render notes as a depth-shaded, drifting graph with animated links
Preview the open note's metadata and rendered content in a side panel
Filter the graph live by title or alias
Navigate between notes with keyboard commands and camera animations
Copy a note's Markdown or an obsidian:// link from the panel
extras: Supports special dictionary-style entries with Usage/Avoid sections rendered as chat bubbles; manual installation instructions are included; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: An alternative graph view for Obsidian
motivation: The author was inspired by the graph visualization Matt Pocock uses for his AI Coding Dictionary.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows a static link map with no built-in note preview, live title/alias filtering, or guided navigation between connected notes.

relations.evidence: Turn on Show all links in the plugin settings to see every link at rest, like Obsidian's graph view
inspired by the visualization Matt Pocock uses for his AI Coding Dictionary
relations.plugin: Matt Pocock's AI Coding Dictionary visualization

summary: Alternative graph view that renders notes as drifting, depth-shaded circles with a side panel previewing each note's content and connections.
